description: A single filled area whose points are joined by straight segments instead of a smoothed curve.
overview: Identical in structure to the default area chart (`AreaChart`, `CartesianGrid`, `XAxis` on `month`), but the `Area` uses `type="linear"`. `chartData` holds six months of `{ month, desktop, mobile }` records; only `desktop` is plotted with `chartConfig.desktop` (`var(--blue)`) at `fillOpacity={0.18}`. The tooltip uses `indicator="line"`.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your own records, keeping a category key for the x-axis and a numeric key for the area. Rename the series in `chartConfig` and in the `var(--color-<key>)` references when you change `dataKey`. Use `type="linear"` when exact values between readings matter more than a smooth trend.
notes: `accessibilityLayer` is set on the chart, so the plot is focusable and arrow keys move the tooltip between months.
